scripts.build:native: npm --prefix native/audio-engine ci && npm --prefix native/audio-engine run build
scripts.build:native:asio: npm --prefix native/audio-engine ci && npm --prefix native/audio-engine run build -- --features asio
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --trace off
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:native:asio && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
